scenario.page: Actual production DOMStage with six independently attached Family H fields; real shared scheduler with scroll-driven uniforms.
scenario.deadline: 110% of per-run idle median rAF; >=95% completed CPU+queue work inside deadline and median workload rAF inside deadline.
scenario.cpuBoundary: First field custom onBeforeFrame hook to shared queue completion; capture is asynchronous and does not serialize rAF.
scenario.css: Public production bindCSSParameters; 0/1/8 selected bindings, 30 warmup +120 manually sampled visible frame hooks, no GPU rendering in timing region.

results.presentationEstimate: RGBA8 logical one-image and three-image estimates; browser swap-chain allocation is not observable
results.samplingLimit: CPU/layout observations of programmatic scroll before and after two rAF callbacks plus queue completion; this cannot observe compositor-only wheel scrolling or prove zero visual latency.
